Flows of [[Air]] can be woven into the form of a three-dimensional object, or '''hardened air''' which can be used in a variety of ways; to hit, cut, stab people or to slice or peel things. This same weave is used to form tentacles or ties to move objects, or hold or restrain things and even to bind people. With them it is also possible to make a covering to shelter beneath or behind.
